instr: Number boxes: keep track of the numbers in a few boxes while instructions change them, then type the final numbers.
clue: You will see a few boxes with numbers. Remember them: the numbers will be hidden. Then instructions appear one by one, telling you to add to or subtract from a box. Keep the numbers up to date in your head. At the end, type the final number of every box (keyboard or on-screen keypad) and press Done. Press Start when ready.
phase_update: Update the numbers in your head.
phase_answer: Type the final number of each box. Tap a box to choose it; Enter moves to the next box.
